items.title: 2.2 Bunyadi zarraat par barqi maidan (electric field) ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.2, printed pages 24-25.

blocks.text: Barqi maidan (electric field) mein zarraat (particles) ka rawaiya un ke mass aur charge par munhasir hai. Agar electrons, protons aur neutrons ki beams ek ek kar ke ek hi raftar se barqi maidan se guzrein to woh yun bartao karti hain.

items: Neutrons, ghair-janibdar (neutral) hone ki wajah se, nahi murte; woh maidan ki simt ke amood (perpendicular) seedhe raste par chalte hain.
Protons, musbat charge wale, manfi plate ki taraf murte hain.
Electrons, manfi charge wale, musbat plate ki taraf murte hain, aur bohat zyada, kyunke un ka mass proton ka 1/1836 hai.

blocks.text: Asal simt se inhiraf (deviation) ki miqdar do tarah napi jati hai: inhiraf ka zawiya (angle of deflection) charge taqseem mass ke mutanasib hai, aur inhiraf ka nisf-qutr (radius of deflection) mass taqseem charge ke mutanasib hai. Radius yeh farz kar ke muqarrar hota hai ke murne ke baad zarra dairawi raste par chalta hai, to radius par asar karne wale awamil (factors) zawiye wale awamil ke ulat hain.

blocks.alt: Ek source oopar surkh musbat plate aur neeche neeli manfi plate ke darmiyan teen beams chhorta hai: neutron ke liye sleti seedhi lakeer, proton ke liye halki neeche murti surkh lakeer, aur electron ke liye tez oopar murti neeli lakeer. Daen taraf ek table har zarre ka charge aur mass aur atomic aur mass numbers ke notes deta hai.
blocks.caption: Ek hi raftar ke protons, neutrons aur electrons barqi maidan mein, Table 2.2 ki khusoosiyat ke saath (Figure 2.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Neutron par koi charge nahi, to woh seedha guzar jata hai. Proton manfi plate ki taraf khincha jata hai magar bhari hone ki wajah se thora sa murta hai. Electron, itne hi charge magar mass ke 1/1836 ke saath, musbat plate ki taraf khincha ja kar tez murta hai. Inhiraf ka zawiya charge taqseem mass ke saath aur mure raste ka radius mass taqseem charge ke saath chalta hai. Table chhape hue charges aur masses dohrata hai: proton +1.6022 x 10^-19 C aur 1.6726 x 10^-27 kg, neutron 0 aur 1.6750 x 10^-27 kg, electron -1.6022 x 10^-19 C aur 9.1095 x 10^-31 kg.

blocks.prompt: Alpha zarraat (charge +2, mass proton ka taqreeban 4 guna) ki beam usi maidan mein proton beam jaisi raftar se dakhil hoti hai. Woh kis plate ki taraf murti hai, aur proton se zyada ya kam?
blocks.explanation: Alpha zarraat musbat hain, to protons ki tarah manfi plate ki taraf murte hain. Un ka charge taqseem mass 2/4 hai, proton ka aadha, to inhiraf ka zawiya chhota hai: woh protons se kam murte hain.

items: Barqi maidan mein neutrons seedhe jate hain, protons manfi plate ki taraf murte hain, electrons musbat plate ki taraf aur bohat zyada (proton ke mass ka 1/1836).
Inhiraf ka zawiya charge taqseem mass ke mutanasib; inhiraf ka radius mass taqseem charge ke.
